messages:
Tom (AE): Start thread for NorthCove POC. They need SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning (users+groups), RBAC sync, and domain-locked admins. Marta is the contact. Ivy can own test tenant. Need Dedicated pricing ballpark.

Marta (Customer): We're on Azure AD. Will share SAML metadata and SCIM token. POC window: 2 weeks.

idp-bot: Reminder: check NameID format before testing.

Ivy (SE): Quick: do you want IdP groups to be authoritative for roles? Also confirm user attrs required (email, displayName, employeeId).

Marta (Customer): Yes, groups authoritative. Need only company domain admins ( *@northcove.io ).

Omar (Solutions Eng): SE checklist: 1) upload metadata to test tenant, 2) verify NameID=email, 3) provision user via SCIM POST /Users, 4) add group -> verify role. Default SCIM rate limit 500/min, can request bump.

Leah (Security): We'll provide SOC2 link, cert rotation runbook, SCIM token rotation guidance, and KMS options for Private. Need to confirm audit export (SAML/SCIM events).

Tom (AE): Ivy can you estimate Dedicated for ~30 concurrent sessions, ~60M tokens/mo? We may offer 30-day eval credits.

Ivy (SE): Rough Dedicated baseline ~$12k/mo. I'll confirm with Sales Ops and prepare an eval credit.

Ivy (SE): Test tenant created: https://play.redwood.ai/northcove-eval  ACS: `https://play.redwood.ai/saml/acs`  EntityID: `https://play.redwood.ai/saml/metadata`. Upload metadata and set NameID=email.

Marta (Customer): Uploaded metadata and set NameID to email. SCIM token will follow in a secure message.

Omar (Solutions Eng): Noted. For RBAC send a CSV: `idp_group,redwood_role`. I'll paste a template after this.

Leah (Security): Action items: I'll attach questionnaire answers and rotation runbook. Tom will share MSA and AUP.

Tom (AE): Thanks. Ivy/Duplicate: run smoke test and post results in thread.

Ivy (SE): Smoke test complete: SSO success, SCIM create -> user visible, group mapping applied. Logging events captured. Posting logs to shared drive.

Marta (Customer): Great — sending final group map now. Thanks all.
